transcript.text: Thank you all for joining. Before I can approve the operating and privacy plan for the morning announcement broadcast pilot, I need to complete the required review round. Could I please get the following: Mr. Greene, I need the exact list of trained host students. Ms. Novak, I need the exact approved platform settings. Mr. Ellis, I need the exact privacy restrictions and required records. Once I have these details, I'll record the factual bases for the final plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the broadcast practicum with six students — J1, J2, J3, J4, J5, and J6. Only those six have completed the school's camera, microphone, and live-broadcast training, so they are the students I can authorize as hosts for the morning announcement broadcast.

transcript.text: I've confirmed that the district's approved student-media platform supports an internal-school audience with a 30-day archive and requires moderator approval before each broadcast. The public-stream setting and 90-day archive in the draft plan are not approved district configurations.

transcript.text: I reviewed a current court-related privacy order naming student K7 that prohibits the school from recording or broadcasting K7's image or voice. K7 is enrolled in journalism and must be excluded from both the host roster and any recorded broadcast, with the exclusion documented in the activity file.

commitments.detail: Record the factual bases for the final plan: the six trained host students (J1–J6) per Mr. Greene's practicum completion, the internal-school audience with 30-day archive and moderator-approval-before-broadcast per Ms. Novak's district platform confirmation, and the exclusion of K7 from both the host roster and any recorded broadcast per Mr. Ellis's privacy-order review.
Ensure K7's exclusion from both the host roster and any recorded or broadcast content is documented in the activity file, consistent with the current court-related privacy order.

Use only the district-approved internal-school audience setting with a 30-day archive and moderator approval before each broadcast; the public-stream setting and 90-day archive from the draft plan are not approved and must not be used.
